sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/sainthelencampground (the township's 'Book Campground Reservations' link; read in a browser, search Tue 2027-04-13, 1 night, 2 adults)

values.note: One rate for everyone (no township-resident rate): rustic sites $25, modern water-and-electric sites $45 ('Prices are subject to change'). Campspot's totals for one night in April 2027 are $28.75 rustic and $49.35 modern, about $3 plus 3% of the site charge in fees. Seasonal sites: availability opens in December.

fees.source: https://richfieldtownship.org/parks-rec/ ('Modern Sites are $45 a night which includes electric (20, 30 and 50 amp hook up) & water. Rustic Sites are $25 a night') + https://www.campspot.com/book/sainthelencampground/search/2027-04-13/2027-04-14/guests0,2,0/list (Modern (Water & Electric) Site $49.35, Rustic Site $28.75 avg per night), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The 20/30/50-amp box at a modern site is shared with the site behind it; the township suggests bringing an adapter.

hookups.source: https://richfieldtownship.org/parks-rec/ ('Includes electric 20, 30 and 50 amp Electrical Box. The Electrical Box is shared with the camper behind you. It is recommended that you bring an adapter') + Campspot (Modern site amenities: 20-Amp, 30-Amp, 50-Amp, Water Hook-Up), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 121 sites: 30 modern water-and-electric (to 60 ft on Campspot) and 91 rustic (Campspot lists 26 modern and 50 rustic online; rustic to 80 ft, 4 pull-through).

sites.source: https://richfieldtownship.org/parks-rec/ ('121 Campground Sites (91 Rustic Sites and 30 Modern Water & Electric Sites)') + Campspot (Modern 'Fits vehicles up to 60 feet long', 26 locations; Rustic 'Fits vehicles up to 80 feet long', 50 locations; Pull-Through 4), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://richfieldtownship.org/parks-rec/ ('We have a Shower/Bathroom Facilities') + Campspot (Wi-Fi at the 26 modern sites), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://richfieldtownship.org/parks-rec/ ('The Campground is open from April 1st to October 31st'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://richfieldtownship.org/parks-rec/ ('Reservations are accepted up to 6 months in advance'; 'Book Campground Reservations' -> https://www.campspot.com/book/sainthelencampground), read 2026-10-22

note: Richfield Township's campground in its oldest park on Airport Road, St. Helen (township airport, ballfields, pavilion, courts; home of the Bluegill Festival and the ORV Jamboree). Direct ORV-trail access from the sites; Lake St. Helen is nearby (the campground sits inland). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the township page and its Campspot booking engine: 121 sites (30 modern, 91 rustic), 20/30/50-amp with water at modern sites, showers, season Apr 1 - Oct 31, booking 6 months ahead. Changed nightly_low 45 -> 25 (rustic sites take RVs to 80 ft on Campspot, so they are the base; modern $45 is the high); added max length 60 ft, pull-throughs, Wi-Fi, Campspot link and window. Phone 989-389-4452 matches the Campspot page (township hall 989-389-4994). Note trimmed of site counts, season, booking and facilities.
flags: Name: the township calls it 'Richfield Township Park & St. Helen Campground' and the booking engine 'Saint Helen Campground' (Richfield Township d/b/a Saint Helen Campground); the entry has 'Richfield Township Campground'.
